# Multi-Step Seller Registration

For marketplaces that require an extensive onboarding process, the module integrates directly with the Webkul Marketplace Landing Page multi-step registration forms (Layout 2 and Layout 3).

---

## Configuration Overview

To enable the dedicated seller registration workflow on the marketplace sell page:

1. Navigate to **Stores > Configuration > Marketplace > Landing Page Settings**.
2. Locate the **Marketplace Landing Page Layout** setting.
3. Choose either **Layout 2** or **Layout 3**.

---

## Case 1 — Multi-Step Onboarding with Layout 2

When **Layout 2** is selected in Landing Page Settings:

![Landing Page Layout 2 Setting](/images/landing_page_layout2_setting.webp)

Prospective sellers navigating to the marketplace sell page experience a progressive 3-step registration wizard:

### Step 1 — Basic Credentials & Shop URL
The seller enters their personal identity details, contact email, desired public **Shop URL**, and password.

![Layout 2 Step 1 - Register As a Seller](/images/layout2_step1_register.webp)

Clicking **Next** moves the seller forward without submitting prematurely.

### Step 2 — Company & Custom Information
In the second stage, custom vendor attributes—such as *Company Name*, *About Company*, *Joining Date*, and custom questionnaire fields—are gathered.

![Layout 2 Step 2 - Create Account Information](/images/layout2_step2_create_account.webp)

Clicking **Next** progresses to final verification.

### Step 3 — Designation, Media Upload & Legal Agreement
In the final step, the seller provides their job designation, uploads identity or facility images, selects their location, and accepts the required **Terms & Conditions** and **Privacy & Cookie Policy**.

![Layout 2 Step 3 - Registration Details & Agreements](/images/layout2_step3_registration_details.webp)

Clicking **Create an Account** submits the complete application for marketplace onboarding.

---

## Case 2 — Multi-Step Onboarding with Layout 3

When **Layout 3** is configured in Landing Page Settings:

![Landing Page Layout 3 Settings Part 1](/images/landing_page_layout3_part1.webp)
![Landing Page Layout 3 Settings Part 2](/images/landing_page_layout3_part2.webp)

The onboarding wizard presents a modern, streamlined progression:

### Step 1 — Initial Registration & Shop Details
The seller completes core identity information, email address, password, and custom shop handle.

![Layout 3 Step 1 - Register As Seller](/images/layout3_step1_register.webp)

### Step 2 — Custom Vendor Attribute Fields
The seller fills in required business attributes and questionnaire inputs.

![Layout 3 Step 2 - Custom Attribute Fields](/images/layout3_step2_custom_fields.webp)

### Step 3 — Media Attachments & Legal Confirmation
The seller uploads credentials, specifies location metadata, reviews legal popups, and submits the registration.

![Layout 3 Step 3 - Details & Legal Agreement](/images/layout3_step3_details_agreement.webp)
